caption:
Heading away for the holidays? Your Pilates doesn't have to go on hold. 🏖️

You don't need a reformer to keep your strength ticking over. Ten minutes on a towel, about three times a week, can help you hold onto most of what you've built.

Hybi's routine, two minutes per block: breathing and 10 bridges, dead bug 8 each side, side-lying leg lifts and circles, bird dog 8 each side, then 10 slow cat-cows to finish. If a move feels sharp, skip it and keep the rest.

Our Pilates team at Hybrid Physio can tweak your home program before you go and progress it when you're back. Book online via the link in bio.

General information only — not a substitute for an individual assessment.
